component.name: Open Pointcloud Studio
component.summary: View, measure, edit and export laser scans and point clouds

description.p: This is a community package of Open Pointcloud Studio, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the OpenAEC Foundation. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Open Pointcloud Studio opens laser scans and other point clouds in the LAS, LAZ, E57, PLY, PCD, PTX and text formats, also when a survey is many gigabytes large: it shows a preview at once and reads the detail for the current view from an index on disk.

A whole scan project opens from its folder. Scanner stations are shown with their photos, and you can stand in a station or walk through the scene. Points can be selected, deleted, thinned, moved and scaled, distances and areas measured, views saved with notes, and the result exported as a point cloud, a mesh, or plans and sections in DXF and DWG, which open in the bundled Open CAD Studio. An MCP server lets an AI agent drive the open window; point the agent at the command flatpak run org.openaec.OpenPointcloudStudio --mcp.

Sandbox: display, GPU and network (the PDOK base map and 3DBAG buildings for scans in the Netherlands). Files and scan-project folders are opened and saved through the file chooser; the disk indexes of large clouds are kept in the app's cache folder under ~/.var/app. Updates come through FlatPark.
